description: Edera — Colore: Apple green & antique white Codice: 5334 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Small Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 64.5 cm × 64 cm Toni: Light green In line with Mariano Fortuny’s love of nature, EDERA is inspired by the flora found in our factory’s garden and throughout Venice and brings the evergreen beauty of ivy into any space.
